Every `from` names a row in tools/comfy/manifest.json, which is the G2-gated transcription of docs/content-bible.md §4 (species) and §6 (towns); the prompt is taken from that row VERBATIM. Species names live here rather than in the .ts because build-doc §8.3 / G3 forbid content literals in code (tests/property/foodweb.test.ts no_shadow_tables).
